component.name: Toast
component.script:
sub init() th = LumenTheme() m.box = m.top.createChild("Group") m.box.id = "box" m.box.opacity = 0 bg = m.box.createChild("Poster") bg.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" bg.blendColor = th.ink bg.width = 520 bg.height = 64 m.label = m.box.createChild("Label") m.label.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 24) m.label.color = th.yellow m.label.width = 520 m.label.height = 64 m.label.horizAlign = "center" m.label.vertAlign = "center"
m.animIn = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.animIn.duration = 0.3 m.animIn.easeFunction = "outCubic" a = m.animIn.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") a.fieldToInterp = "box.opacity" a.key = [0, 1] a.keyValue = [0, 1] b = m.animIn.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") b.fieldToInterp = "box.translation" b.key = [0, 1] b.keyValue = [[700, 90], [700, 80]]
m.animOut = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.animOut.duration = 0.25 m.animOut.easeFunction = "inCubic" c = m.animOut.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") c.fieldToInterp = "box.opacity" c.key = [0, 1] c.keyValue = [1, 0]
m.timer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.timer.duration = 2.4 m.timer.observeField("fire", "hide") end sub
sub show() m.label.text = m.top.message m.animOut.control = "stop" m.animIn.control = "start" m.timer.control = "stop" m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub hide() m.animOut.control = "start" end sub
